newsitem.title: USA: Turner Corp sees continued cost rises in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Turner Corp sees continued cost rises in Q4.

text.p: Turner Corp said Tuesday that construction costs continue to increase in the fourth quarter of 1996.

According to Turner, the Turner Building Cost Index for the fourth quarter is expected to increase 0.8 percent to 510, four points above the previous quarter, and 2.82 percent higher than the fourth quarter of 1995. This represents the seventh consecutive quarter where the forecast has increased less than one percent, the company said.
Turner Corp is a provider of construction and program management services in the non-residential building market.
